An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 2 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that burns. The attacker spends 38 dollars and 7 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
